app.name: A11yTextHelper
help.step_1_body: Results appear as you type. Use the Platform filter in Settings to choose Web or Native App findings (most are web-focused). Try +required -excluded to narrow results (e.g. keyboard +screen reader -wcag2.2).
help.step_2_body: Each result has Rank Up and Rank Down buttons to change how it ranks. Star a result to make it always appear first. Pin any result to keep it at the top across all searches.
help.step_3_body: Select the finding that best matches. Results are ranked by relevance.
help.step_4_body: Add a location prefix (e.g. "Global:") or use AI Assist to revise the wording. Describe what you observed and the AI will tailor the finding to your context.
help.step_5_body: Copy the description and suggested fixes directly into your spreadsheet or report. Use Copy All to grab both fields at once.
help.shortcuts_note: Shortcuts are only active when focus is on the result list. Use them to quickly navigate and rate findings without leaving the list.
help.take_tour_description: See an interactive walkthrough of how to search, rank results, and copy findings.
onboarding.heading: Welcome to A11yTextHelper
onboarding.confirm_body: You have not reached the end of the tour. Close now and skip the rest?
onboarding.slide_1_body: Search by symptom, WCAG success criterion, or component name. Filter by platform (Web or Native) and WCAG level. Use Narrow Results to search within what is already showing. Results are sorted by search relevance, then by severity.
onboarding.slide_2_body: Use Rank Up/Down to rank results by importance. Star a finding to always show it first. Pin a finding to keep it at the top across all searches.
onboarding.slide_3_body: Open a finding to see the title, WCAG success criterion, description, and suggested fix. Add a location note to the description (e.g. "Global:"), use AI Assist to revise any field, then copy each field individually, or use Copy All to grab everything at once.
about.what_body: This app helps you write accessibility audit findings. When auditing websites and apps, you find the same issues many times. Instead of rewriting the same description every time, this tool lets you find, customize, and copy findings you have written before.
about.what_body_2: Your audit findings are consistent across reports. Search a library of pre-written descriptions aligned to WCAG standards. Pick one that matches what you found. Add the specific location or context. Then copy it into your audit report.
about.what_wcag: This data extends up to {wcag} (Level A and AA).
about.step_1_body: Type what you observed: a component name, element type, or plain-language description.
about.step_2_body: Each result has Rank Up and Rank Down buttons to change its ranking. Star a result to make it always appear first. Archive to hide. Pin any result to keep it visible at the top across all searches.
about.step_3_body: Select the finding that best matches. Results are ranked by relevance.
about.step_4_body: Add a location prefix (e.g. "Global:") or use AI Assist to revise the wording. Describe what you observed and the AI will tailor the finding to your context.
about.step_5_body: Copy the description and suggested fixes directly into your spreadsheet or report. Use Copy All to grab both fields at once.
about.feature_ai_body: Use AI to rewrite a finding based on your notes. Your API key stays in your browser. It is never sent to our servers. Set it up in
about.feature_languages_body: The UI is available in over 50 languages including RTL support. Switch in Settings.
about.feature_party_body: It is in Settings. Under Appearance. You will know it when you see it.
about.feature_pinning_body: Pin any finding to keep it at the top across all searches and views. Use rank up/down to reorder results, star to float a finding to the very top, or archive to remove it from view.
about.feature_a11y_body: Built to WCAG 2.2: focus management, live regions, keyboard navigation, reduced motion support, and high-contrast tokens.
about.sources_body: Entries are written in plain language, near-duplicates are consolidated, and each is aligned to a specific WCAG success criterion. Sources consulted include:
about.coming_auth: Optional sign-in with Google or GitHub to sync your settings across devices.
about.coming_custom: Add and edit your own custom findings, stored privately in the cloud.

detail.edit_lang_warning: Edits are session-only. Switching language or finding will reset them.
edit.target_dialog_body: You're editing a finding while viewing it in {locale}.
edit.save_as_personal_desc: Stored locally on this device and private to you. Other languages will be AI-translated unless you edit them manually. Translations update during site maintenance.
edit.contribute_desc: Your edit will be queued for the maintainer to review before it becomes part of the shared corpus.
edit.scope_all_langs_desc: Other languages will be re-translated from the updated English on the next translation pass.
edit.personal_ai_warning: Only {locale} will be saved. Other languages will show AI-translated text. Translations update during site maintenance.
edit.en_switch_dialog_body: Your {locale} version is saved. Here's the English version of the same finding. Make any edits and save, or skip to leave the English version unchanged.
detail.revise_desc_checkbox: Include Finding Details / Description in revision
detail.agentic_mode_help: AI searches past examples to match your style and technical depth when rewriting
detail.agentic_mode_hint: AI will search past examples to match your established style and technical depth
detail.revise_error_body: Something went wrong while revising. Press Save & Revise Selected to try again.
detail.revise_error_invalid_key: Invalid or expired API key ({provider}). Double-check your key in Settings.
detail.revise_error_rate_limit: Rate limit reached ({provider}). Wait a moment and try again.
detail.revise_error_service_error: {provider} service error ({status}). Try again in a few seconds.
detail.revise_error_network_error: No internet connection. Check your connection and try again.
settings.heading: Settings
settings.language_desc: Use the dropdown and Change button below to select a new one. The change will not be saved until you press the Save button at the bottom.
settings.language_changed_announce: Language: Changed, press Save button to confirm
settings.ranking_on: Ranking controls are visible on each result.
settings.ai_enable_desc: Rewrites text based on your refinement notes.
settings.privacy_body_1: API keys stay in your browser. They go only to the AI provider. We never see them. You can delete them anytime by clearing your browser's site data.
settings.privacy_body_2: This app stores these things locally in your browser: theme, language, platform filter, search setting, AI provider choice, API keys, your rankings, stars, pinned items, recent findings, custom findings, and your last opened finding. Nothing else is stored. Nothing is sent to us.
settings.privacy_body_translations: UI translations and base public corpus translations were generated with AI and may contain errors or missing data. No custom or user-entered data is ever sent out for translation.
settings.api_key_error: Error: API key is required when AI Assist is enabled.
settings.agentic_mode_desc: AI will search past examples to match your style and technical depth when rewriting.
settings.pinned_results_desc: Items you have pinned appear above all search results.
settings.starred_results_desc: Items you have starred rise to the top when sorted by rating.
settings.archived_results_desc: Items you have archived are hidden from search results.
settings.confirm_reset_all_intro: This action will permanently delete everything listed below and reset to defaults. This cannot be undone.
settings.confirm_reset_all_item_ratings: All finding ratings (rank up, rank down, stars, archived)
settings.confirm_reset_all_will_keep: Everything below will be reset to defaults:
settings.unsaved_body: You have unsaved changes to your AI settings. What would you like to do?
settings.reduced_motion_note: You have reduced motion turned on, and we are actively acknowledging that system setting. Animations like confetti will be skipped until you change it in your OS accessibility settings.
settings.wcag_filter_desc: Filter findings by the WCAG version and conformance level you are auditing to. Each version includes all findings from earlier versions.
